newsitem.title: KENYA: 10,000 Kenyans homeless after Mombasa slum fire.
newsitem.headline: 10,000 Kenyans homeless after Mombasa slum fire.

text.p: Fire swept through a Mombasa slum over the weekend, destroying the homes of 10,000 people, Kenyan television reported on Monday evening.
The report, monitored by the BBC, did not mention any deaths or injuries in the Sunday night blaze in Kisimani slums of the Indian Ocean port's Kisauni Division.
It said thousands of homless people were camping in churches and mosques and appealing to the government for assistance.
